blockers.name: Sieve Extras
blockers.detail: Focus mode, data saver, regional lists, your own rules

sections.title: Ads on specific sites
sections.footer: Hides ad slots on these sites. Sites change their layouts often, so these work on a best-effort basis. Safari content blockers can't stop YouTube's in-video ads.

sections.title: Block a company everywhere
sections.footer: Blocks that company's scripts, pixels and embeds on every other website. Their own sites keep working.

sections.title: Focus mode
sections.footer: Blocks these websites entirely in Safari.

sections.title: Data saver & speed
sections.footer: Aggressive options. Expect some sites to look or work differently.

sections.title: Regional ad lists
sections.footer: Turn on the languages you browse in.

filters.title: Ad networks & banners
filters.detail: The main ad list: blocks ad servers and hides ad slots on most sites, including mobile sites.

filters.title: Video ad networks
filters.detail: Pre-roll and outstream video ad players on news and blog sites.
filters.warning: Can stop some embedded video players from starting.

filters.title: Search engine ads
filters.detail: Sponsored results on Google, Bing, DuckDuckGo and Yahoo.

filters.title: YouTube banners & feed ads
filters.detail: Promoted videos, banner ads and overlay ads. In-video ads can't be blocked by Safari blockers.

filters.title: Reddit promoted posts
filters.detail: Hides promoted posts in feeds and comment pages.

filters.title: Amazon sponsored products
filters.detail: Hides “Sponsored” listings in Amazon search results and product pages.

filters.title: Trackers & analytics
filters.detail: Blocks tens of thousands of tracking scripts, pixels and analytics servers.

filters.title: Session recorders
filters.detail: Scripts that record your clicks, scrolling and typing (Hotjar, FullStory, Clarity and more).

filters.title: Meta (Facebook, Instagram)
filters.detail: Facebook pixel, Like buttons, Instagram embeds on other sites.

filters.title: Google
filters.detail: Google Analytics, ads, fonts, Maps and YouTube embeds on other sites.
filters.warning: Breaks “Sign in with Google”, reCAPTCHA and embedded maps and videos on other sites.

filters.title: Amazon
filters.detail: Amazon ads, affiliate widgets and tracking on other sites.

filters.title: Microsoft ads & analytics
filters.detail: Bing ads tracking, Clarity and MSN widgets on other sites.

filters.title: TikTok / ByteDance
filters.detail: TikTok pixel and embeds on other sites.

filters.title: X (Twitter)
filters.detail: X ads pixel, embedded posts and share buttons on other sites.

filters.title: LinkedIn
filters.detail: LinkedIn Insight tag and share buttons on other sites.

filters.title: Pinterest
filters.detail: Pinterest tag and Pin buttons on other sites.

filters.title: Snapchat
filters.detail: Snap pixel on other sites.

filters.title: Yandex
filters.detail: Yandex Metrica and ads on other sites.

filters.title: Cookie consent banners
filters.detail: Hides “We use cookies” pop-ups and bars.

filters.title: Newsletter & sign-up pop-ups
filters.detail: Subscribe boxes, “before you go” pop-ups and overlays.

filters.title: Other annoyances
filters.detail: Floating bars, self-promotion and other page clutter.

filters.title: AI assistant pop-ups
filters.detail: Hides “Ask AI” prompts and AI suggestion boxes that sites add to pages.

filters.title: Push-notification prompts
filters.detail: “Allow notifications?” services such as OneSignal and PushEngage.

filters.title: Chat & support bubbles
filters.detail: Live-chat and feedback widgets in the page corner.
filters.warning: You won't be able to use a site's live chat.

filters.title: Social share buttons
filters.detail: Like, Share and Follow buttons and social widgets.

filters.title: Comment sections
filters.detail: Hides comments under articles (Disqus, OpenWeb, Viafoura and common layouts).

filters.title: Malware sites
filters.detail: Sites currently spreading malware, from the abuse.ch URLhaus database.

filters.title: Phishing sites
filters.detail: Fake login pages that try to steal passwords, from PhishTank and OpenPhish.

filters.title: Crypto miners
filters.detail: Scripts that use your phone to mine cryptocurrency.

filters.title: Hidden click tracking
filters.detail: Blocks background “ping” beacons sent when you tap links.

filters.title: Pop-up windows to other sites
filters.detail: Stops pages opening new windows or tabs on another website.
filters.warning: Can break “Sign in with” and payment pop-ups.

filters.title: Social media
filters.detail: Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, X, Reddit, Snapchat, Threads, Pinterest, Tumblr, Bluesky.

filters.title: Video & streaming
filters.detail: YouTube, Netflix, Twitch, Hulu, Disney+, Max, Prime Video and more.

filters.title: News sites
filters.detail: Major news sites and news aggregators.

filters.title: Shopping
filters.detail: Amazon, eBay, Walmart, Target, Etsy, Temu, Shein, AliExpress and more.

filters.title: Games
filters.detail: Browser game sites and game stores.

filters.title: Web fonts from other sites
filters.detail: Skips downloading Google Fonts, Typekit and other hosted fonts.

filters.title: All web fonts
filters.detail: Uses your phone's built-in fonts everywhere.
filters.warning: Icons on some sites turn into empty boxes.

filters.title: Scripts from other sites
filters.detail: Only lets a site run its own JavaScript. Very fast and private.
filters.warning: Expert mode: many sites will break. Add them to Allowed Sites.

filters.title: Embedded frames from other sites
filters.detail: Blocks embedded videos, maps, widgets and many ads.
filters.warning: Breaks embedded videos and some checkout pages.

filters.title: Video & audio
filters.detail: Stops videos and audio loading on web pages.

filters.title: All images
filters.detail: Text-only browsing for slow connections.

filters.title: German
filters.detail: Ads on German-language sites.

filters.title: Russian & Ukrainian
filters.detail: Ads on Russian- and Ukrainian-language sites.
